svg.title: What a sketched distribution constraint tests: three projections of a collapsed cloud
svg.desc: Left, a two-dimensional cloud lying on the diagonal with standard deviation one in each coordinate, and three unit directions at 0, 45 and 135 degrees. Right, three histograms of the cloud projected onto those directions, each against the standard normal curve. Along 0 degrees the variance is 1, matching the target. Along 45 degrees it is 2 and along 135 degrees it is nearly 0.
svg.text: yet the cloud is a line (correlation 1)
